{{Quote|This ship is no longer the ''Imperious''. I intend to give it a new name, one that the Sith hate and fear to hear amongst their enemies. From now on this ship shall be known as the ''Alliance''.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]|<ref name="SWL22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>}}
The '''''Alliance''''', originally known as the '''''Imperious''''', was a large, powerful warship built by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] ruled by [[Darth Krayt]]. It was the prototype of the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]], a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] design larger and more powerful than the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class]]. It was a personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] Admiral [[Gar Stazi]].

==History==
===Construction===
{{Quote|It's an impressive ship, Lieutenant Dubrok. A tribute to Mon Calamari engineering.|[[Gial Gahan]] to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Strom Dubrok]]|<ref name="SWL20" />}}
[[Darth Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and Emperor of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new galactic empire]], had made a demand for a new class of warship that could overpower any type of ship used by the Empire's numerous enemies. With this demand, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]], the head of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], proposed the idea of the ''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer, an upgrade of the ''Pellaeon''-class.

The ''Imperious'' was constructed in the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] in [[137 ABY]], at the time under control of the usurper faction of the Empire. It was one of the largest ships in the Empire, as well as the pride of the Imperial Navy. For its maiden voyage, the ''Imperious'' was to be operated by skeleton crews.

===Theft===
{{Quote|We need to make military strikes, and for that, we need the ''Imperious''!|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]|<ref name="SWL20" />}}
Meanwhile, the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] was one of the major opponents of Krayt's empire. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], the Alliance's leader, heard of the ''Imperious'', and knew this was something they couldn't pass up. Stazi made plans to steal it, asking his old friend [[Gial Gahan]] to assist with it.

But on the day Stazi and his fleet made the attempt, they were trapped. Admiral [[Dru Valan]], an Imperial commander with a personal vendetta against Stazi, had known about Stazi's plans and set up a trap to capture or kill Stazi and destroy his fleet.<ref name="SWL20" /> What Valan didn't know was that Stazi was prepared for the trap, and turned the Imperials' trap against them.

Stazi ordered his fleet to [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]]. When Valan ordered a return fire and fire from the shipyards, the shipyards joined the Alliance in firing on the Imperial fleet, having been hacked by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue member]] [[Monia Gahan]]. Meanwhile, the ''Imperious'' was retaken by the Alliance; the stormtroopers that had seized it were actually Alliance commandos in disguise. Led by [[Hondo Karr]], they piloted the ship away from the shipyards and successfully got it out of the system. After this, the Alliance fleet retreated behind the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and were able to escape and make it to the rendezvous point. The ''Imperious'' was now in the hands of the Galactic Alliance Remnant. They then began the process of bringing its weapon systems online.<ref name="SWL21" />

===Alliance Flagship===
[[File:ImperiousAlliance.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Imperious'' with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] fleet]]
Stazi appointed the ship as his new [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the successor to the [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']].

The Alliance, however, was unaware that [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]] had sabotaged the ''Imperious''; activation of the ship's weapons would cause the detonation of three series of bombs that would destroy the vessel. However, Monia Gahan and [[Imperial Knight]] [[Sigel Dare]] were able to warn Admiral Stazi. The bombs were deactivated and Stazi, impressed that Fel's forces were willing to help him, asked Dare to tell Fel that he was willing to once again negotiate an alliance against the Sith. He also renamed the ship the ''Alliance''.<ref name="SWL22" />

Meanwhile, Darth Krayt was furious that Stazi had escaped with his best ship, and ordered the [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] of the Mon Calamari for two reasons: to punish the Mon Calamari and try to dissuade any further resistance to his empire.<ref name="SWL22" /> However, while this move did cow some systems into line, many more were outraged and allowed ships from their defense fleets to join Stazi's forces. This was presumably intensified with the death of Krayt on Had Abbadon.

As the vessel was properly outfitted for battle, its sides were adorned with the symbol of the Galactic Alliance,<ref name="SWL36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref> in a similar fashion to the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', when it was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] over a hundred years before.<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]''</ref>

Under the command of Admiral Stazi, the ''Alliance'' fought against the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]]. However, Stazi and his crew didn't know there was a [[Tealart|traitor]] onboard their ship.<ref name="Legacy 2006 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref> The traitor's betrayal led to an assassination attempt on Stazi and an [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|attack]] by the [[First Coruscant Task Force]]. Fortunately, the assassination attempt failed and the Imperial fleet was outmanuevered and forced to retreat. The traitor, despite deeply regreting his actions, was imprisoned and later expected to be court martialed and executed.
[[File:SWLegacy47.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Alliance'' fighting over [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].]]

===Imperial attack on Dac===
The ''Alliance'' was present over Dac when the [[One Sith|Sith]] poisoned the waters of the ocean [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in an effort to wipe out every living thing&mdash;but [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] wasn't ready to abandon the native [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] without an attempt at evacuation.

The ''Alliance'' led an attack on the Sith forces stationed in orbit above Dac, which succeeded in driving the Sith into retreat. When the Outer Rim Third Fleet responded, the ''Alliance'' once again led the Remnant's attack. While at first the forces were relatively evenly matched, Imperial forces loyal to Roan Fel arrived and helped turn the tide in the Alliance's favor. The Sith retreated once again, and the evacuation continued. But the evacuation only succeeded in rescuing about twenty percent of the planet's 27 billion inhabitants before the poison made it too deadly to continue.
